title: Zoo Explorer Trail
hook: A hidden animal can still teach us patience.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool zoo-explorer storybook, map-and-binocular mood, friendly habitats, clean isolated animal subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child making respectful zoo field notes
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: field-note cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/sketch gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a binocular-click woodblock followed by a warm marimba confirmation.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a binocular-click woodblock followed by a warm marimba confirmation
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Zoo Explorer Trail a welfare-and-field-note protocol: read signage, observe at distance, distinguish natural behavior from visitor expectation, and connect zoo education to conservation without claiming every facility is equal.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child ranger records one behavior, one habitat clue and one unanswered question per exhibit; hidden animals count as a valid observation.
